newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi Aramco cuts Aug propane, butane flat-traders.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco cuts Aug propane, butane flat-traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil firm Saudi Aramco cut its propane contract price for August by $3.00 from the previous month to $172 per tonne, but kept its price for butane unchanged at $192, traders said on Wednesday.
The propane price for August is up $12 from a year ago, while the butane price is up $17 from last year.
The Saudi contract prices are loosely based on the results of three monthly spot tenders and the company's own assessment of spot market trends.
